headline: Goranboy district features extensive school networks and low paved road share.

tags.reason: The district provides 13.13 schools per 10,000 residents compared to the national median of 4.14.
The nature index score stands at 46 while the national median is 52.

summary: Goranboy has a population of 102,800 across an area of 1,784.1 km² with a population density of 60 people per km². The district records 1.26 pharmacies and 7.49 groceries per 10,000 residents, against national medians of 0.18 and 2.29 respectively. Infrastructure is constrained by a paved road share of 0.2 percent among known surfaces, while the national median is 4.35 percent. OSM data coverage is high, but price data is entirely absent from the records.
